hero.title: What if your tool evolved with you, without overloading you with useless features?
hero.subtitle: Stop wasting time looking for a tool built for solo users, minimalist by default, that cleans your workspace on its own: NuxiPro does the essentials and simplifies your daily life.

pourquoi.label: Why I built this software
pourquoi.p1: I was using proprietary solutions I couldn't audit, and they didn't solve my problem: my workspace was becoming a graveyard of completed tasks.
pourquoi.p2: I tried todo lists and kanbans: they share one thing in common, tasks stay visible even when they're done. I tried Todoist but it didn't move tasks to a dedicated archive space, so they reloaded in the background every time I opened the page, which hurt performance.
pourquoi.p3: So I decided to build this minimalist tool, deliberately limited to the essentials, sovereign and respectful of your privacy. It's also open source: you'll never be locked into the software, your data is yours and you can migrate to a VPS or dedicated server to self-host with peace of mind.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: NuxiPro is a minimalist personal task manager that automatically cleans your Kanban board by archiving completed tasks.
faq.q2: Is NuxiPro built for team collaboration?
faq.a2: No team features for now. NuxiPro stays solo-first: personal productivity without team overhead, notifications, or clutter. Team remains a possible optional upgrade later — only once solo is fully ready, not before, and only if you want to evolve.
faq.q3: How does automatic task archiving work?
faq.a3: The demo archives tasks instantly when moved to Done — data stays in your browser only. In the cloud version, you simply choose your archiving mode at sign-up: instant archiving or archiving after X days.
faq.q4: Can I test NuxiPro right now?
faq.a4: Yes, you can try the free interactive demo directly at demo.nuxipro.com without creating an account.
faq.q5: How can I access the full version of NuxiPro?
faq.a5: The full version (app.nuxipro.com) is currently in development and not accessible yet. You can join the waitlist to get early access at launch.
faq.q6: Can I still find my tasks once they are archived?
faq.a6: Yes, all archived tasks are safely stored and remain accessible at any time in your dedicated archive area.
faq.q7: Is the cloud version of NuxiPro minimalist?
faq.a7: Yes. I use NuxiPro Cloud for my own projects, so I keep only the essentials: solo-first by default, no team overhead, no Jira-like onboarding with endless fields. You learn it once by using it. Team features may come later, strictly optional — only once solo is fully ready, never required upfront.
faq.a8:
No.

The current demo at demo.nuxipro.com is not open source and is time-limited: it will be stopped.

It will be replaced by an open-source, very simplified Cloud-based demo without account (browser-limited, time-limited storage) only after NuxiPro Cloud is ready — not before, to avoid wasting time on a demo while Cloud is not ready.

This is planned, no date promised.

Don't use the current demo for real work: data stays in your browser and can be lost.
faq.q9: Is NuxiPro open source and self-hostable?
faq.a9: Yes. NuxiPro Cloud is open source (AGPLv3) on Codeberg and self-hostable, but not production-ready: still in development.
faq.q10: Where is NuxiPro hosted and is it GDPR-compliant?
faq.a10:
NuxiPro Cloud is hosted in Finland (UpCloud, Europe) and your data stays in Europe.

GDPR roadmap: legal hub, documented sub-processors, consent traceability.

Honest black spots (Cloud version only, not your data): frontend + DNS on Cloudflare (US company) and monitoring via OpenObserve (US company even with EU servers).

Planned: migrate DNS + frontend away from Cloudflare and self-host OpenObserve in my own infra for full sovereignty when means allow — for now, I stay on their managed services.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.desc: What the landing page collects in the cloud, and what the demo stores in your browser.
privacy.intro: The essentials first, the details after. No collected data can identify you.

inshort.s1: No cookies, nothing written to your browser for audience measurement.

tools.title: Who measures what

tools.posthog: PostHog (EU Cloud) — pages, source and time on page, via a server-side hashed identifier (daily salt, IP never kept after hashing).
